correctness.rationale: Primitive excursion decomposition yields the exact composition character polynomial. Each signed partial derivative is a product of two lower-length signed sums. The algebraic identity H=z+z H^2/(1-2H) proves the all-negative values are 1,0,positive for n>=3. Induction yields all-character positivity and the exact Fine minimum; ordinary Catalan enumeration yields the maximum. Standard singularity expansion gives the limiting ratio nine. The standalone exact verifier passed 69,432 checks, independent of the all-length proof.

The nearest published Fourier result instead encodes individual up-step positions of height-restricted paths; neither its kernel nor theorem implies this unrestricted interior-return-position spectral positivity. Six targeted semantic searches did not identify a covering theorem; this is bounded originality assessment, not proof of priority.
